exposure: Spontaneous preterm birth (preterm labor or preterm premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: The study included 710 late preterm neonates delivered between 34+0 and 36+6 weeks of gestation.
finding: Medically-indicated preterm birth (without fetal compromise) is associated with the highest risk of neonatal respiratory morbidity compared to maternal/fetal-indicated or spontaneous preterm birth.
